title: On Cross-Validation for Hyperparameter Optimization of Deep Learning Image Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2608.14705v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) can materially affect the performance of deep learning (DL) image classifiers, but there is little empirical guidance on how to derive the validation signal that drives it, especially for the small sample sizes common in fields such as medical imaging. We compared three HPO protocols in terms of {\em   absolute performance-estimation error} (AEE; the absolute difference between the winning configuration's validation AUROC and its test AUROC): fixed holdout (F), reshuffled holdout (R), and 5-fold cross-validation (C). The search space, sampler, training procedure, architecture, and test set were held identical across protocols. We evaluated the protocols on three public datasets spanning two regimes: binary medical imaging (RSNA pneumonia radiographs and binarized HAM10000 skin lesions) and 200-class natural imaging (Tiny ImageNet), across a range of development set sizes $n$ and two backbones (ResNet-1

translated_title: 深度学习图像分类器超参数优化的交叉验证研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14705v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：超参数优化（HPO）能显著影响深度学习（DL）图像分类器的性能，但关于如何推导驱动其验证信号的经验指导很少，尤其是在医学影像等领域常见的小样本情况下。我们比较了三种HPO协议在绝对性能估计误差（AEE；即获胜配置的验证AUROC与测试AUROC之间的绝对差异）方面的表现：固定留出法（F）、重排留出法（R）和5折交叉验证（C）。搜索空间、采样器、训练过程、架构和测试集在所有协议中保持一致。我们在三个公共数据集上评估了这些协议，涵盖两种场景：二元医学影像（RSNA肺炎放射图像和二值化HAM10000皮肤病变）以及200类自然影像（Tiny ImageNet），并跨一系列开发集大小$n$和两种骨干网络（ResNet-1）进行评估。
tldr: 本研究比较了三种超参数优化验证协议（固定留出、重排留出和5折交叉验证），发现它们在不同数据规模和场景下对深度学习图像分类器性能估计的准确性存在显著差异，为小样本医学影像等应用提供了实用指导。
en_tdlr: This study compares three hyperparameter optimization validation protocols (fixed holdout, reshuffled holdout, and 5-fold cross-validation) and reveals significant differences in their accuracy for estimating deep learning image classifier performance across data sizes and scenarios, providing practical guidance for small-sample medical imaging applications.
